en: A black‑and‑white photograph showing a large hydroelectric dam and spillway in a forested landscape. Water rushes through multiple sluice gates beneath tall concrete towers, then cascades down a rocky channel. Two narrow pedestrian bridges span the turbulent water below the dam, with several small human figures standing on them. Coniferous and leafless deciduous trees frame the river gorge, while open fields and low hills stretch into the distance. The image is bordered by a white margin, in the style of a vintage postcard. No visible text appears on the front.
